notes.title: The Backrooms Free Content Update #1
notes.content:
Over the next few months we will be issuing a total of 3 updates, each containing more content for the game. Today we release the first such update. Here are the changes to look for, without spoiling much:

* New zone added
* New ending to discover
* Various bug fixes
* Performance updates
* Video/audio options added - perhaps there's a hidden meaning here...

Enjoy.
